typography_policy: U09CD for every visibly printed hasanta; insert ZWNJ only to prevent an unprinted ligature between visibly separate consonants. Existing U09CD fields requiring only ZWNJ are classified rendering-only, not missing-glyph material failures. No hasanta inferred from pronunciation.
source_language_identity_review: Every printed comparator language label checked; uncertain geographic/historical labels remain explicit and unmapped rather than guessed.
কর্মিজ remains glyph/identity uncertain; no equivalence inferred.
মুন্ডা/মুন্ডারি label cluster shape deserves owner font comparison; no blanket standard-spelling correction proposed.
কাকমারা (দ্রাবিড়), কায়েথী (বিহার), সেরবাদিয়া, যবদ্বীপীয়, শবর and generic আঞ্চলিক বাংলা/প্রাকৃত remain source-specific labels until independent mapping evidence.
p100 final label বাংজবংশী is printed anomalously and must retain typo evidence, not silently normalize.
p100 Mizo target explicitly described as currently unused; register metadata must preserve that statement.
scope_findings: All84 physical comparison rows and all5 embedded witnesses accounted.
p99 মোলি prints চা twice: competing Chakma/Chang interpretations must remain unresolved.
p100 তুদুং has slash glosses without local language allocation; do not copy another chapter allocation as if printed here.
Parenthetical homo, Thap-tshang and Zwal retain explicit source-text roles, not invented additional dialect forms.
Comparisons do not by themselves establish loanword or ancestry edges.
method: Every original detail image p100–103 read; narrow6x crops checked selected virama/cluster/embedded cases. Owner JSON/TSV unchanged; no installation or build.
